content.title: Sunderland vs. Tottenham free livestream: How to watch Premier League game, TV, time
content.text: Tottenham Hotspur's Mathys Tel, left, and Sunderland's Lutsharel Geertruida battle for the ball during the English Premier League soccer match between Tottenham Hotspur and Sunderland in London, Sunday Jan. 4, 2026. (John Walton/PA via AP)APIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By Thomas Lagrone | tlagrone@al.comSunderland plays against the Tottenham Hotspur in a Premier League game today. The matchup is scheduled to begin at 8 a.m. CT on USA Network. Fans can watch this game for free online by using the free trial offered by DIRECTV. Alternatively, Sling offers an affordable monthly subscription. Sunderland enters this matchup with an 11-10-10 record, so the team currently has 43 points. Notably, the team is only six points away from fifth place. In their most recent Premier League game, Sunderland defeated Newcastle United 2-1. In order to win this game, Sunderland will need to rely on its star forward Brian Brobbey. He leads the team with six goals in the Premier League this season. Tottenham enters this matchup with a 7-9-15 record, so the team only has 30 points. Due to their poor record, the Tottenham squad is only one point away from the relegation zone. In their last Premier League match, Tottenham lost 3-0 against Nottingham Forest. In order to bounce back today, Tottenham will need a great performance from its forward Richarlison. He leads the team with nine goals in the Premier League this year. Fans can watch this Premier League game for free online by using the free trial offered by DIRECTV.
